assumptions: Exact k-mer matching, as EMBOSS polydot does it.
limits: Ranks which pairs share material; it is not an alignment or a tree.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which members of this sequence set share material with which, as an all-against-all grid of dot plots?

description: All-against-all dot plot over a sequence SET — EMBOSS `polydot`. Every ordered pair is plotted with the exact k-mer engine and laid out as an N×N grid, so shared regions, repeats and inversions across a whole family are visible in one picture. Answers a different question from `dot_plot`, which compares exactly two: this one ranks which members share material and how much. Wire many upstream record/sequence outputs into `sequences`, or name library documents.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

best_path_only.description: reduce each panel's forward runs to a non-overlapping best path (EMBOSS dotpath). Advanced.

convert_wobbles.description: expand IUPAC ambiguity codes so a wobble matches what it stands for. Advanced.

gap.description: residues of blank space drawn between panels in the composite layout (EMBOSS default 10). Advanced.

include_subject.description: also include the node's subject (the open or wired record) as a member of the set.

max_residues.description: refuse when the set's total residue count exceeds this. In bp. Advanced.

max_sequences.description: refuse a set larger than this rather than starting N² comparisons. Advanced.

max_unknown_percent.description: percentage of a k-mer allowed to be N (or X for protein) before it is skipped. In %. Advanced.

reverse_complement.description: plot each pair against the reverse complement too. Not an EMBOSS capability — ours, so an inversion between two members is visible.

sequences.description: the set to compare all against all — wire several upstream outputs here, or list library document names/ids.

word_size.description: k. EMBOSS polydot's default is 6, which is smaller than dottup's because a grid of short panels needs a shorter word to show anything. In bp.

name: dot_plot_grid

grid.description: the full result — every panel's runs plus its offset in the composite coordinate space

memberCount.description: members in the set (the grid is this squared)

sequences.description: the set as plotted, in grid order, with each member's length

sharingPairs.description: off-diagonal panels carrying at least one shared word — how connected the set is, the leading diagonal excluded because a member always matches itself

summary.description: EMBOSS's per-sequence table — name, length, and the matches drawn in that sequence's whole column
